case_studies.title: Work with a pulse.
case_studies.subtitle: A few products, platforms, and digital homes we pushed from idea to something people can actually use.

project.description: We designed and developed a custom e-commerce home for Plus 44, a Dutch streetwear brand with attitude. The result is a shop that lets the products, visuals, and buying flow do the talking.

challenges.title: Plus 44 needed a store that looked as sharp as the clothes, with product pages and visuals that could carry the brand without over-explaining it.
description: Implementing smart solutions like IDeal payment

project.solution: We combined Shopify, custom code, and 3D visuals to create a richer shopping experience without making the buying journey complicated.
project.result: A modern e-commerce presence with stronger brand character, clearer product storytelling, and a smoother path from drop to checkout.

project.description: We tuned up Allersnelste Nanie's website for structure, speed, and trust, giving a practical Dutch electrical company a digital presence that works harder.

challenges.title: Allersnelste Nanie needed a website refresh that could load faster, feel clearer, and help visitors find the right service without wandering off.

project.solution: We audited the existing site, rebuilt the weak spots, tightened the content structure, and improved the technical foundation.
project.result: A faster, clearer website structured for multiple locations, with a smoother path from first click to customer inquiry.

project.description: We redesigned and rebuilt A1 Maatwerk's website so a skilled contractor no longer had to rely on an outdated digital first impression.

challenges.title: A1 Maatwerk needed a site that matched the quality of the work: cleaner design, easier navigation, stronger structure, and more reasons to get in touch.
description: Redesigning the website based on existing brand identity
Implementing a new design and user experience
Developing the website using modern technologies
Integrating the website with a content management system

project.solution: We shaped a custom design and development plan around the existing brand, then rebuilt the experience with stronger structure and performance.
project.result: A modern website with cleaner UX, improved performance, stronger contact paths, and an easier content setup.

project.description: Pod Skrzydlami came to us as a new business needing the whole digital starter kit: identity, website, structure, and enough polish to look established from day one.

challenges.title: Pod Skrzydlami needed a full identity and website that could make accounting feel approachable, credible, and far less beige than people expect.
description: Developing the website using modern technologies
Integrating the website with a content management system

project.solution: We created the logo, color system, typography, website structure, and content-ready pages around a calm but distinctive brand direction.
project.result: A complete brand and web presence that feels professional, friendly, easy to use, and ready for real clients.

project.description: We shaped a louder visual direction for The Gaming Monster, built for instant recognition, high-impact imagery, and a digital identity with teeth.

challenges.title: The Gaming Monster needed a visual system with energy, edge, and enough discipline to survive beyond one flashy asset.
description: Keeping the identity sharp across digital formats

project.solution: We built a compact creative system around the cover art, messaging hierarchy, and reusable presentation patterns.
project.result: A punchy project identity with a strong visual hook and a flexible foundation for future brand and content work.

project.description: We gave Two Sleepy People a warm, characterful digital direction: soft where it should be, polished where it counts.

challenges.title: Two Sleepy People needed a presentation that could feel calm and memorable without putting the user to sleep.
description: Building a clear foundation for future web content

project.solution: We translated the concept into a clean visual system with stronger image treatment, focused copy structure, and responsive layout thinking.
project.result: A memorable project entry with a refined digital starting point and a more polished visual presence.

project.description: We created a sweet, playful website for Cakes it easy, a home bakery making custom cakes, cupcakes, cookies, and special-event treats. The site was custom programmed and paired with original graphics to match the brand's cute, feminine personality.

challenges.title: Cakes it easy needed a website that felt as charming as the bakes themselves: soft, girly, easy to browse, and still clear enough to turn sweet cravings into custom orders.
description: Creating a cute visual direction without losing readability
Designing custom graphics that support the bakery's personality
Building a responsive website for special-event orders
Presenting cakes, cookies, and cupcakes in a clear service structure

project.solution: We designed and programmed a custom website around soft visuals, playful graphic elements, and a simple content flow that makes the bakery's offer feel personal and easy to understand.
project.result: A charming digital home for Cakes it easy with a recognizable look, custom-made graphics, and a polished website experience that fits the brand's handmade sweetness.

process.title: From fuzzy idea to shipped product.
process.subtitle: We keep the process lean, visual, and honest. You always know what we are making, why it matters, and what happens next.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: We get close to the idea, the users, the constraints, and the thing you are really trying to build. Then we turn the messy parts into a clear brief.

steps.title: Shape
steps.description: We map the product flow, screens, features, content, and technical direction before pixels get precious. This becomes the buildable plan.

steps.title: Design & Build
steps.description: Design and development move together. Interfaces get polished, backends get wired, and the product starts behaving like a real thing.

steps.title: Launch & Tune
steps.description: We test, polish, ship, and stay close after launch. The first version should feel solid, and the next version should already make sense.

FAQ.title: Questions before we build?
FAQ.subtitle: Good. The best projects start with a few sharp questions and zero pretending.

faq_tiles.title: Who is behind Media Control Agency?
faq_tiles.description: Media Control Agency is run by Bart with a compact team of designers and developers. Small enough to stay sharp, experienced enough to build serious products.

faq_tiles.title: What is included in your plans?
faq_tiles.description: Depending on the project, we cover product thinking, UX/UI design, web or app development, backend work, revisions, testing, and launch support. The scope is clear before we start.

faq_tiles.title: Why choose us over hiring a full-time designer and developer?
faq_tiles.description: You get a design-and-build team without payroll, recruitment, management overhead, or waiting three months to move. We bring the product taste and the technical hands.

faq_tiles.title: What if I'm not satisfied with the design or result?
faq_tiles.description: We work in visible steps, so surprises stay small. If something is not there yet, we refine it together until the product feels right and does what it needs to do.

faq_tiles.title: How quickly will I receive my project?
faq_tiles.description: Small requests can move in a few business days. Larger products get a real timeline based on scope, complexity, and launch goals. We keep it honest.

faq_tiles.title: What if I only have a single request?
faq_tiles.description: Absolutely. A single project is perfect for a website, MVP, app screen set, backend feature, or focused product rebuild.

faq_tiles.title: Do you offer refunds if I'm not satisfied with the service?
faq_tiles.description: Refunds depend on the agreement and project stage. Our real focus is avoiding that situation by setting a clear scope, showing work early, and keeping the collaboration direct.

paragraphs: For the initiation of business relations, the processing of orders and the execution of contracts between Media Control Agency and customers as well as potential customers (both hereinafter referred to as "Business Partners"), the following applies in addition to our privacy policy with regard to the exchange of information and data (hereinafter referred to as "Confidential Information"):

The parties are obliged to secrecy in respect of the following terms (hereinafter referred to as “Terms”).

2. Media Control Agency and its “Business Partner” have an interest in sharing information, checking data and facilitating discussions. Both parties will attach great importance to the mutual protection of information and will treat it confidentially at all times.
3. “Confidential Information” includes, but is not limited to:

In the case of information disclosed orally or in written materials that are not marked as confidential, secrecy shall only apply in cases where it is obviously a matter of secrets or insofar as the necessity for confidentiality is pointed out subsequently. privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.headline: Privacy Policy of Media Control Agency
paragraphs: The following privacy policy specifies the rules for storing and accessing data on users' devices via the website, for the purpose of providing electronic services by the administrator, and the rules for collecting and processing personal data voluntarily provided by users through the tools available on the website.
This privacy policy is an integral part of the website's terms, which describe the rules, rights, and obligations of users using the website.

definitions.title: §1 Definitions
items: Service - the "Media Control Agency" website operating at https://media-control-agency.com/
External service - websites of partners, service providers, or recipients cooperating with the administrator

Website / Data Controller - The website administrator and data controller (hereinafter the administrator) is the company "Media Control Agency", located at Narcis 7, 1619 BC Andijk, with VAT number: NL004874490B47
User - a natural person to whom the administrator provides electronic services via the website.
Device - an electronic device with software that allows the user to access the website
Cookies - text data collected in the form of files placed on the user's device
GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016
Personal data - information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person
Processing - an operation or set of operations performed on personal data
Restriction of processing - marking stored personal data to limit its processing
Profiling - automated processing of personal data to evaluate certain personal factors
Consent - voluntary, specific, informed, and unambiguous expression of will to process data
Personal data breach - a breach of security leading to destruction, loss, alteration, or unauthorized access
Pseudonymization - processing of personal data in a way that prevents identification without additional information
Anonymization - irreversible process that destroys or overwrites personal data, making identification impossible

sections.title: §2 Data Protection Officer
paragraphs: In accordance with Art. 37 of the GDPR, the administrator has not appointed a data protection officer.
For matters related to data processing, including personal data, contact the administrator directly.

sections.title: §3 Types of cookies
list: Internal cookies - files placed and read by the website's IT system on the user's device
External cookies - files placed and read by IT systems of external websites on the user's device
Session cookies - files placed and read by the website during one session on the user's device
Persistent cookies - files placed and read by the website on the user's device until manually deleted

sections.title: §4 Data Storage Security
paragraphs: The mechanisms for storing, reading, and exchanging data between cookies stored on the user's device and the website are implemented via browser mechanisms and do not collect other data from the user's device.
Internal cookie files used by the administrator are safe and do not contain scripts or malicious content.
The administrator monitors external services but does not have full control over their cookies and is not responsible for their security.
Users can manage cookie settings in their browser. Guides are available for Chrome, Firefox, Opera, Edge, Safari, and Internet Explorer.
The administrator takes measures to secure cookie data, but the user is also responsible for the security of their device.
The administrator ensures that personal data is processed securely and that access is limited and in accordance with the purpose of processing.

sections.title: §5 Purposes for which cookies are used
list: Improving and facilitating access to the website

sections.title: §6 Purposes of personal data processing
paragraphs: Personal data voluntarily provided by users is processed for:
- Provision of electronic services
- Communication between the administrator and users
- Ensuring the legitimate interest of the administrator
Anonymous data is processed for:
- Tracking statistics
- Understanding how visitors use the website
- Ensuring the legitimate interest of the administrator

sections.title: §7 Cookies from external websites
paragraphs: The administrator uses scripts from partners who may place cookies. Users can manage these cookies via browser settings.
Partners include:
- Google Analytics (statistics)
These services are beyond the administrator's control and may change their privacy policy or cookie behavior.

sections.title: §8 Types of data collected
paragraphs: The website automatically collects anonymous data and personal data voluntarily provided by users.
Anonymous data includes:
- IP address, browser type, screen resolution, location, visited subpages, operating system, previous page, referrer, language, internet speed, internet provider
Personal data includes:
- Name, email, website address, phone number, IP (collected automatically)
Newsletter data includes:
- Name, email, IP address
Some data may be stored in cookies or shared with statistics providers (without identifying users).

sections.title: §9 Access to personal data by third parties
paragraphs: In principle, only the administrator has access to personal data.
Access may be granted to service providers such as hosting companies, under a data processing agreement.
Hosting is provided by https://atthost.pl/ in Poland, with possible access for service maintenance.

sections.title: §10 Method of personal data processing
paragraphs: Personal data is not transferred outside the EU unless published by the user.
There is no profiling or sale of personal data.
Anonymous data may be transferred outside the EU and used for profiling, but is not linked to a person or sold.

sections.title: §11 Legal basis for personal data processing
§12 Retention period of personal data
paragraphs: Personal data is retained only as long as the service is active, after which it is deleted or anonymized within 30 days.
If necessary to protect legitimate interests, data may be retained for up to 3 years.
Anonymous data may be retained indefinitely for statistical purposes.

sections.title: §13 Users' rights regarding personal data processing
list: Right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority

sections.title: §14 Contact with the administrator
list: Postal address - Media Control Agency, Narcis 7, 1619 BC Andijk, Netherlands

sections.title: §15 Website requirements
paragraphs: Restricting cookies may cause the website to malfunction.
The administrator is not responsible for problems caused by restricting cookies.

sections.title: §16 External links
paragraphs: The website may contain links to external sites not affiliated with the administrator. These may carry risks and are not the responsibility of the administrator.

sections.title: §17 Changes to the privacy policy
paragraphs: The administrator may change this privacy policy without notifying users regarding anonymous data or cookies.
Changes regarding personal data will be notified to users by email within 7 days.
Continued use implies acceptance of the changes.
Changes take effect upon publication.
